_doc: G4 daily GPU-hour budget ledger, recorded per GPU type. Keyed by local date (pick ONE timezone; it defines the midnight reset boundary; sacct prints US/Eastern, so label the clock of every timestamp and take it from a date call, never an estimate). Keep one ledger of record with one writer, fed from sacct as well as the submit path, so hand-submitted jobs, jobs cancelled while pending (0 GPU-h), array tasks and every run of a requeued job are booked: key rows by (JobIDRaw, Start) and store Start as started_at, because sacct -D lists each requeued run under the same JobIDRaw. gpu_hours = elapsed_hours x n_gpus; gpu_hours_used and gpu_hours_by_type are the sums over the day's jobs. soft_cap_gpu_hours_per_day covers all types; soft_cap_by_type is optional; a cap near the per-user QOS ceiling is only a runaway guard. The decision loop reads remaining-today before any T1 submit; pause T1 when it goes negative. Write atomically (tmp + rename), stdlib-only.
